notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Thornbite Staff attached to Adun.
Adun does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Adun triggers, untapping Adun.
Activate Adun by paying {B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
